1.en: Praise to the Lord of the worlds, Master of the Day of Judgement
1.ar: حمدُ ربِّ العالمين مالكِ يوم الدين

1.en: You alone we worship, You alone we ask for help
Guide us on the straight path

18.en: Praise for the straight Book; earth's adornment is a test
18.ar: الحمد لله الذي أنزل على عبده الكتاب — زينة الأرض ابتلاء

18.en: Stay patient with those who call on their Lord
18.ar: واصبر نفسك مع الذين يدعون ربهم

18.en: The parable of the two gardens
This life like rain-fed plants; the lasting good deeds
Iblīs refuses to bow; man the most argumentative
18.ar: إبليس يأبى السجود — وكان الإنسان أكثر شيء جدلا

18.en: Moses and the knowing servant: the boat, the boy, the wall
18.ar: موسى والعبد الصالح: السفينة والغلام والجدار

18.en: Dhū al-Qarnayn and the barrier against Gog and Magog
The Trumpet; the greatest losers; the sea as ink for His words
18.ar: النفخ في الصور — الأخسرون أعمالا — لو كان البحر مدادا

36.en: By the wise Qurʾān: the Messenger warns; deeds are recorded
The people of the town and the man who came running
36.ar: أصحاب القرية والرجل الذي جاء يسعى

36.en: Signs: the dead earth, night and day, sun and moon, the laden ship
36.ar: آيات: الأرض الميتة والليل والشمس والقمر والفلك

36.en: Turning away, then a single blast and the rising
The people of the Garden: “Peace” — a word from a merciful Lord
36.ar: أصحاب الجنّة — سلامٌ قولًا من ربٍّ رحيم

36.en: The guilty set apart; mouths sealed, hands and feet speak
36.ar: وامتازوا اليوم أيّها المجرمون — نختم على أفواههم

36.en: Not poetry but a reminder; the gift of cattle; false gods
Who will revive bones? He who made them: “Be!” and it is

55.en: The All-Beneficent taught the Qurʾān; the balance; earth's bounty
55.ar: الرحمن علّم القرآن — الميزان — نِعَم الأرض

55.en: Man from clay, jinn from fire; the two seas; all on earth will pass
55.ar: خلق الإنسان والجانّ — مرج البحرين — كلّ من عليها فان

55.en: The reckoning: no escape; the guilty known by their marks
Two gardens for whoever feared standing before his Lord
And besides them, two more gardens; blessed is His Name
55.ar: ومن دونهما جنّتان — تبارك اسم ربك

56.en: When the Event befalls: you will be three groups
56.ar: إذا وقعت الواقعة — وكنتم أزواجًا ثلاثة

56.en: Have you considered: the seed of life, the crops, the water, the fire?
By the setting of the stars: a noble Qurʾān none touch but the purified
56.ar: فلا أقسم بمواقع النجوم — قرآن كريم

56.en: When the soul reaches the throat; certain truth
56.ar: فلولا إذا بلغت الحلقوم — حقّ اليقين

67.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is sovereignty; seven flawless heavens
67.ar: تبارك الذي بيده الملك — سبع سماوات طباقًا

67.en: Hell for the deniers: “Did no warner come to you?”
Fear of the Unseen; He made the earth tractable
67.ar: يخشون ربهم بالغيب — جعل لكم الأرض ذلولا

67.en: Are you secure? The birds held up by the All-Beneficent
He gave you hearing, sight and hearts; who would bring you water?
67.ar: السمع والأبصار والأفئدة — من يأتيكم بماء معين

77.en: When the Day of Sorting comes

78.en: What are they asking about? The great news
Signs: the earth a cradle, mountains pegs, sleep, night and day, rain
78.ar: ألم نجعل الأرض مهادًا والجبال أوتادًا

78.en: The Day of Sorting: the Trumpet, the opened sky
Hell lies in wait for the transgressors
The Spirit and angels in ranks; “I wish I were dust!”
78.ar: يوم يقوم الروح — يا ليتني كنت ترابًا

79.en: Oaths by those who draw out and direct affairs
The quake, trembling hearts, a single cry
79.ar: يوم ترجف الراجفة — فإنّما هي زجرة واحدة

79.en: Moses and Pharaoh: “I am your lord most high”
79.ar: هل أتاك حديث موسى — أنا ربّكم الأعلى

79.en: Are you harder to create, or the sky?
The great catastrophe: Hell for the rebel, Paradise for who restrained himself
79.ar: فإذا جاءت الطامّة الكبرى — ونهى النفس عن الهوى

80.en: He frowned and turned away from the blind man
How ungrateful is man: from a drop, to the grave, to the rising
Let man look at his food
The deafening blast: fleeing one's brother, mother, father
80.ar: فإذا جاءت الصاخّة — يوم يفرّ المرء من أخيه

81.en: When the sun is folded up: the cosmos undone
When souls are paired, the buried girl asked, records spread: a soul will know
81.ar: وإذا النفوس زُوّجت — علمت نفسٌ ما أحضرت

81.en: By the receding stars: the word of a noble messenger
81.ar: فلا أقسم بالخُنّس — إنّه لقول رسول كريم

81.en: Your companion is not mad; a reminder for the worlds
81.ar: وما صاحبكم بمجنون — إن هو إلا ذكر للعالمين

82.en: When the sky is cleft apart
O man, what lured you from your generous Lord?
82.ar: يا أيّها الإنسان ما غرّك بربّك الكريم

82.en: The pious in bliss, the wicked in fire; that Day the command is Allah's
82.ar: إنّ الأبرار لفي نعيم — والأمر يومئذ لله

83.en: Woe to those who give short measure
The record of the wicked is in Sijjīn
The record of the pious is in ʿIlliyyūn
They laughed at the believers; today the believers laugh
83.ar: إنّ الذين أجرموا كانوا من الذين آمنوا يضحكون

84.en: When the sky splits open and the earth is stretched
O man, toiling toward your Lord: the record in the right hand or behind the back
84.ar: إنّك كادحٌ إلى ربّك كدحًا — فأمّا من أوتي كتابه بيمينه

84.en: By the twilight and the full moon: stage after stage
84.ar: فلا أقسم بالشفق — لتركبنّ طبقًا عن طبق

84.en: Why do they not believe, nor bow when the Qurʾān is recited?
84.ar: فما لهم لا يؤمنون — وإذا قُرئ عليهم القرآن لا يسجدون

85.en: By the sky of the constellations, the promised Day
Punishment for persecutors, gardens for believers
Your Lord's grip is severe; the Forgiving, the Loving
85.ar: إنّ بطش ربّك لشديد — وهو الغفور الودود

85.en: Pharaoh and Thamūd; a glorious Qurʾān on a preserved tablet
85.ar: هل أتاك حديث الجنود — بل هو قرآن مجيد

86.en: By the night-comer, the piercing star: every soul has a guardian
86.ar: والسماء والطارق — إن كلّ نفس لمّا عليها حافظ

86.en: Let man see what he was created from; the Day secrets are tested
86.ar: فلينظر الإنسان ممّ خُلق — يوم تُبلى السرائر

86.en: It is a decisive word, not jest
They plot, and I plot: give them a little time

87.en: Glorify the Name of your Lord Most High
We shall make you recite, and you will not forget
So remind: the God-fearing heed, the wretched turn away
Successful is who purifies himself; the scriptures of Abraham and Moses
87.ar: قد أفلح من تزكّى — صحف إبراهيم وموسى

88.en: The Overwhelming: faces humbled, scorching fire
88.ar: هل أتاك حديث الغاشية — وجوهٌ يومئذ خاشعة

88.en: Faces joyful in a lofty garden
88.ar: وجوهٌ يومئذ ناعمة — في جنّة عالية

88.en: Do they not look at the camel, the sky, the mountains, the earth?
88.ar: أفلا ينظرون إلى الإبل كيف خُلقت

88.en: So remind; to Us is their return
88.ar: فذكّر إنّما أنت مذكّر — إنّ إلينا إيابهم

89.en: By the dawn and ten nights
ʿĀd, Thamūd and Pharaoh: your Lord is ever watchful
89.ar: ألم ترَ كيف فعل ربّك بعاد — إنّ ربّك لبالمرصاد

89.en: Man tested by honour and by want; the orphan and the poor
89.ar: فأمّا الإنسان إذا ما ابتلاه ربّه — كلّا بل لا تكرمون اليتيم

89.en: When the earth is pounded flat: “I wish I had sent ahead for my life”
89.ar: إذا دُكّت الأرض — يا ليتني قدّمت لحياتي

89.en: O soul at peace, return to your Lord, well pleased

90.en: By this city: man created into toil
90.ar: لا أقسم بهذا البلد — لقد خلقنا الإنسان في كبد

90.en: Did We not give him two eyes, a tongue and lips, and show him the two ways?
90.ar: ألم نجعل له عينين — وهديناه النجدين

90.en: The steep ascent: freeing a slave, feeding the orphan and the poor
Counsel patience and compassion: the people of the right

91.en: Seven oaths: sun, moon, day, night, sky, earth, and the soul
Successful is who purifies it, lost who buries it
Thamūd and the she-camel of Allah

92.en: By the night and the day: your strivings differ
92.ar: والليل إذا يغشى — إنّ سعيكم لشتّى

92.en: Whoever gives and is God-wary — ease; whoever withholds — hardship
92.ar: فأمّا من أعطى واتّقى — وأمّا من بخل

92.en: Ours is the guidance; a blazing fire for the denier
The most God-wary gives, seeking only his Lord's Face
92.ar: وسيُجنّبها الأتقى — ابتغاء وجه ربّه الأعلى

93.en: By the morning light: your Lord has not forsaken you
93.ar: والضحى — ما ودّعك ربّك وما قلى

93.en: Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you, and provide?
So the orphan, the one who asks, and your Lord's blessing
93.ar: فأمّا اليتيم فلا تقهر — وأمّا بنعمة ربّك فحدّث

94.en: Did We not open your breast and raise your mention?
94.ar: ألم نشرح لك صدرك — ورفعنا لك ذكرك

94.en: When you are free, strive; to your Lord turn
94.ar: فإذا فرغت فانصب — وإلى ربّك فارغب

95.en: By the fig and the olive, Mount Sinai and this safe city
Man made in the finest form, then brought low — except believers
95.ar: لقد خلقنا الإنسان في أحسن تقويم

95.en: Is not Allah the most just of judges?

96.en: Read in the Name of your Lord who created, who taught by the pen
96.ar: اقرأ باسم ربّك الذي خلق — علّم بالقلم

96.en: Man oversteps when he sees himself self-sufficient
Have you seen him who forbids a servant to pray?
96.ar: أرأيت الذي ينهى عبدًا إذا صلّى

96.en: Do not obey him: bow down and draw near

97.en: We sent it down on the Night of Power, better than a thousand months
Angels and the Spirit descend; peace until the dawn
97.ar: تنزّل الملائكة والروح — سلامٌ هي حتى مطلع الفجر

98.en: They would not leave off until the clear proof came
98.ar: حتى تأتيهم البيّنة — رسولٌ من الله

98.en: Commanded only to worship Allah sincerely, pray and give zakāt
98.ar: وما أُمروا إلا ليعبدوا الله مخلصين له الدين

98.en: The worst of creatures and the best of creatures

99.en: When the earth is shaken and casts out its burdens
That day it will tell its news
An atom's weight of good, an atom's weight of evil
99.ar: مثقال ذرّة خيرًا يره — مثقال ذرّة شرًّا يره

100.en: By the charging horses at dawn
Man is ungrateful to his Lord, fierce in love of wealth
When the graves are emptied and hearts laid bare

101.en: The Striking Calamity — what is it?
People like scattered moths, mountains like carded wool

101.ar: فأمّا من ثقلت موازينه — وأمّا من خفّت موازينه

102.en: Rivalry in more distracted you until you reached the graves
You will know; you will see it with the eye of certainty
Then you will be asked about the blessings

103.en: By time, man is in loss
Except those who believe, do good, and counsel truth and patience
103.ar: إلا الذين آمنوا… وتواصوا بالحقّ وتواصوا بالصبر

104.en: Woe to every slanderer who hoards wealth
He will be flung into the Crusher

105.en: The people of the elephant: their plot came to nothing
105.ar: ألم ترَ كيف فعل ربّك بأصحاب الفيل

105.en: Birds in flocks, stones of baked clay

106.en: The winter and summer journeys of Quraysh
Let them worship the Lord of this House, who fed them and kept them safe

107.en: Who denies the Judgement: repels the orphan, ignores the poor
Woe to those who pray heedlessly and withhold small kindness

108.en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice
Your enemy is the one cut off

109.en: Say: I do not worship what you worship
109.ar: قل يا أيّها الكافرون — لا أعبد ما تعبدون

109.en: To you your religion, to me mine

110.en: When Allah's help and victory come, and people enter in crowds
Glorify with praise and seek His forgiveness

111.en: Perish the hands of Abū Lahab
His wife, the firewood-carrier, a rope of fibre on her neck
111.ar: وامرأته حمّالة الحطب — حبلٌ من مسد

112.en: Say: He is Allah, One; Allah, the Self-Sufficient
112.ar: قل هو الله أحد — الله الصمد

112.en: He neither begets nor was begotten; none is like Him
112.ar: لم يلد ولم يولد — ولم يكن له كفوًا أحد

113.en: Refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of creation
From the dark night, the blowers on knots, the envier

114.en: Refuge in the Lord, King and God of people
114.ar: قل أعوذ بربّ الناس — ملك الناس — إله الناس

114.en: From the slinking whisperer, of jinn and people

201.en: By Your mercy that encompasses all things
The asking of one in need
Would You punish me after this?
The cry from within the Fire

201.ar: أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ

202.en: Lord of the great light, O Ever-Living
Gladden the Prophet; the closing call
